subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about scaling paid subscribers for {Brand} the way we have for specialty SVOD like Crunchyroll and MUBI. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the first paid subscription and bid toward cohorts that renew, while trial tourists who churn before the first renewal get weighted down. On that approach we run a 42% trial-to-paid conversion, well above the category median. If it helps, I can pull the trial-to-paid cohort view for your titles. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate first-paid-subscription + renewal-weighting proof
